accepted_declaration_forms.rule: A publisher-controlled raw HTTP response header whose field name case-insensitively equals Source-Kind or X-Source-Kind and whose OWS-trimmed value case-insensitively equals exactly one frozen enum token: public or synthetic.

An XML/HTML element whose local name exactly equals one of source_kind, source-kind, sourceKind and whose text value, after XML/HTML character decoding and outer-whitespace trimming only, case-insensitively equals public or synthetic.

An XML/HTML attribute whose local name exactly equals one of source_kind, source-kind, sourceKind and whose value, after character decoding and outer-whitespace trimming only, case-insensitively equals public or synthetic.

An HTML meta element with name or property exactly equal to one of source_kind, source-kind, sourceKind and content exactly equal after outer-whitespace trimming, case-insensitively, to public or synthetic.

Publisher-controlled body text contains an exact standalone label-value statement using source_kind, source-kind, or source kind, followed by ':' or '=', whose complete value token is exactly public or synthetic. No semantic synonym mapping is allowed.

cardinality_and_conflict_rule.exactly_one_admissible_declaration: Evaluate all six standing requirements; ESTABLISHED only if all pass.
cardinality_and_conflict_rule.multiple_admissible_declarations: REANALYSIS_INCOMPLETE_FAIL_CLOSED even if values are identical; act identity is ambiguous.

explicitly_non_admissible: the words official, regulation, statute, law, government, or Canada without an explicit source_kind label
OpenGraph metadata not explicitly keyed source_kind/source-kind/sourceKind
JSON-LD type or @id not explicitly keyed source_kind/source-kind/sourceKind
if_established_claim_ceiling: An ESTABLISHED result may establish only that the already-acquired publisher/content-issuer response contains one explicit source_kind declaration with a literal frozen enum value and that all six frozen standing requirements are satisfied for CA-3/source_kind. It may record the externally declared value as observed. It may not claim OIC created that value, may not populate SOURCE_MANIFEST.csv, and does not establish source_locator, rights, provenance, redistribution permission, legal clearance, full manifest admissibility, causal root cause, or generality.
if_not_established_claim_ceiling: A NOT_ESTABLISHED result establishes only that this preregistered secondary analysis of the exact frozen response did not find an admissible explicit source_kind declaration. It does not establish that no such declaration exists elsewhere or authorize inference of public from government hosting, XML format, accessibility, or the final URL.
research_question: Does the already-frozen publisher-controlled CA-3 response contain a completed, attributable source-origin declaration explicitly scoped to source_kind and literally declaring exactly one frozen allowed value (public or synthetic), sufficient under the frozen external source-origin authority family without OIC inferring the value?

standing_evidence_requirements.act_integrity_or_digest_binding: The raw headers/body and prior acquisition receipt remain byte-identical to their frozen SHA-256 bindings.
standing_evidence_requirements.actor_identity_evidence: The explicit source_kind declaration must occur in the exact raw publisher response already bound to CA-3 by the closed acquisition result.
standing_evidence_requirements.authority_basis_evidence_external_to_oic: The declaration must be emitted inside the publisher/content issuer's own bound response; OIC may recognize but may not author or synthesize it.
standing_evidence_requirements.ca3_scope_evidence: The declaration is contained in the exact response record already bound to CA-3 by the consumed acquisition closure.
standing_evidence_requirements.completed_act_evidence: Exactly one admissible explicit source_kind declaration form is present.
standing_evidence_requirements.target_field_scope_evidence: The declaration key/label explicitly names source_kind/source-kind/sourceKind; document type, MIME type, or generic origin metadata is insufficient.

target_manifest_field.reason: The reanalysis tests both frozen allowed enum values and may not select or infer a desired value in advance.
